method: All66 original native PNGs decoded RGBA8, compared with same-readback native SHA256, losslessly re-encoded WebP then decoded and independently compared byte-for-byte. No resize/crop/altered pixels. Exact original PNG epochs retained ignored. Byte-identical native images share one lossless WebP by verified native RGBA hash; distinct original encoded PNG hashes and runtime frame records remain separate.
